## AGGREGATES

```{r}
data_long %>% 
  filter(name == "water_stable_aggregates_mwd") %>% 
   ggplot(aes(x = plot, y = value, color = horizon))+
  geom_point(size = 3, width = 0.1)+
#  facet_wrap(~source + name, scale = "free_y")+
    labs(y = "stable aggregates mwd")
```
